ai-hair-color-changer-openapi-skill v1.0.0 — initial release.

- Enables AI-powered hair color changes while preserving hairstyle and details.
- Provides secure API integration; requires a WeShop API key.
- Supports image upload, run initiation, and result polling via OpenAPI endpoints.
